theme: An open Saturday, girls still home before tomorrow's handoff.
greeting: A wide-open Saturday, Dan — nothing on the calendar, and the girls are with you and Mike in St. Pete until tomorrow's changeover. The one thing on the horizon is the 15-minute Sunday review first thing tomorrow, so tonight is a good moment to glance at the board.

needsAttention.title: The Sunday board review lands at 9
needsAttention.detail: Tomorrow opens with the 15-minute review with Mike on your calendar, built to put an owner and a date on everything and kill what's slipped. Several board items are weeks overdue, so arrive having decided what to promote and what to drop.

needsAttention.title: The Pathfinder drive window starts Monday
needsAttention.detail: On the Mike + Dan board, the Portland-to-St-Pete drive is slotted for the Oct 5-18 off-week — that window opens in two days. Dates and the one hotel night still need locking before you're on the road.

needsAttention.title: December trip decision is past its date
needsAttention.detail: The December-break shortlist was due to be decided Sept 30 and booked by Oct 15, and holiday inventory for six over three weeks is the thinnest of the year. Pick domestic or refundable-international and lock it at the review.

flagged.title: Apple flags a new sign-in
flagged.detail: An AppleCare One notice says a new Apple Account signed in to your iPhone 17e and asks you to sign in to keep coverage. Worth confirming it's really you before acting on it.

flagged.title: Amex October statement is ready
flagged.detail: Your October statement posted and the notice flags important notice(s) to review when you're online.

flagged.title: Drew's notes on the ICGN bio
flagged.detail: Drew replied with suggestions on your moderator bio and the LinkedIn announcement for the ICGN Toronto panel — ready for you to finalize and post.

inbox.noise: The rest is newsletters, promos, and receipts — Wildgrain, Amtrak, Monocle, Dermstore, an Evite RSVP, and a couple of Apple order pings.

recipe.title: Roast chicken smothered with chanterelles
recipe.why: Chanterelles are at their autumn peak, and a slow roast is exactly the comfort the season calls for.

tasks.title: Get three term-life quotes for Mike

acts.line: Nothing on the calendar from open to close — a genuinely clear Saturday.
An uncommitted stretch with the girls in St. Pete before tomorrow's handoff.
A few minutes on the Mike + Dan board tonight makes tomorrow's 9 AM review quick.
